summary: Tabs with variant="line": bare text tabs with an underline on the active one, used as a view switcher with no panels.
use: Page headers and view switchers where the tabs change what the page shows, not a panel under the list.
spec: 3 triggers: `board`, `list`, `timeline`, each with a `data-testid` forwarded to the button
A line below the tabs reads `Showing the {view} view.`
